prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine ONLY the far-left hero navigation list in this supplied game UI. The user explicitly approved the complete RIGHT-HAND composition, including the large central hero card and attached details/equipment panel. Do NOT change anything at x>=300 (on the1564x1008 reference) except no-op preservation. No redesign of hero card, stats, skill panel, values, equipment, stone borders, spacing or characters on the approved right.

DESIGN INTENT: the left side is a fast hero selector. It should be calmer, more compact and clearly subordinate to the big selected hero. Current two gigantic mini-cards have redundant nested thick frames. Replace the left list entries with two compact PORTRAIT+NAME ROWS inside ONE shared stone-backed list container.

LEFT TITLE: keep exact text "英雄与装备", reduce to a restrained clear ~34px ivory Chinese serif title, left-align at x24 with the list below. Top around y36. Leave a clear 28px gap from title to list. No title plaque or extra ornament.

LEFT LIST CONTAINER: keep exactly ONE grey-brown softly beveled hand-painted stone frame, same material family but visually lighter than the selected hero card. Bounds approximately x20..266, y110..410. Dark continuous matte inset. Clean inner padding ~16px, generous gap between two entries. It wraps only the two rows, does not extend to screen bottom. Keep quiet plain dark screen background beneath it. No third hero, fake count, tabs, plus button, pagination or scroll arrows for only two sample entries.

ROW1 around y145..249: a small ~84x100px OVAL HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS portrait at x42 showing the same selected red-scarf/black-haired/conical-hat swordsman. Crop face clearly inside a slim warm-bronze rim, NO large stone mini-card, no parchment name banner underneath. To its RIGHT, at x140,y190, show exact name "追刃客" in clear warm ivory ~26px. The entire row has one very subtle warm selection wash, no outlined tile; a small solid muted-gold triangle on the INNER RIGHT EDGE of the container points right toward the selected-hero panel. Rim highlight is matte, NO neon bloom.
ROW2 around y276..381: same-size oval close head portrait, matching the existing white-haired black/gold-robed caster. Slim subdued grey rim. Exact name "回潮术士" to the right in quieter readable ivory ~24px, fit within list width; no ellipsis, no subtitle. No selection highlight on this row. Both rows align names at same left x and portrait centers on same vertical axis.

Keep character faces recognizable; the small portraits are intentionally face closeups while the big selected card remains unchanged. Do not add stats, badges, tier or descriptions to these navigation rows. Keep only two names and portraits plus one selection marker.
The result must have one contained compact navigation list with two horizontal entries, clear distinction between selector and selected-card composition, restrained tactile grey stone, open negative space below, and the EXACT original right region untouched. No giant shared screen background frame, no new decorative panels, no glossy shine, no layout shifts outside the left ~280px. Preserve full canvas and Chinese readability.
status: Approved for production implementation; whole-screen background omitted; component backboards retained.
